name: Huawen Media Group
summary: Huawen Media Group operates in the media business in China. The company engages in information dissemination services and related product sales, distribution, and printing; and capital investment business. It also provides video information; software information; management; tourism, leisure, and sightseeing services. The company was formerly known as China Media Group and changed its name to Huawen Media Group in June 2018. Huawen Media Group was founded in 1991 and is based in Haikou, China.
